## Purpose

What API behavior or infrastructure problem does this change address?

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run format:check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm test` using the isolated development test database
- [ ] README / endpoint reference updated if the API contract changed
- [ ] Frontend compatibility reviewed where relevant

## Security and data impact

- [ ] All mutations validate input and verify administrator authorization
- [ ] No production data, secrets or session cookies committed
- [ ] Index / migration / deployment implications documented
